{{Quote|It's called 'bribe-on-the-run.' This stuff is good currency, especially to a junior officer who probably hasn't seen a payment voucher in months.|Han Solo|<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>}}
'''Chandrilan [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]]''' was an expensive [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage presumably from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The leader of the [[Desert Wind]], [[Thak Val Zsing]], consumed a lot of the beverage.<ref name="CD">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] kept a cache of it aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to bribe port officials: one bottle of it cost Solo two thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" />
